therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: pediatric patients with recurrent/refractory solid tumors including neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, Ewing's sarcoma, osteosarcoma, and other sarcomas
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Phase 1: dose-limiting toxicities and safety; Phase 2: overall response rate

results.effect_size: Phase 2 ORR: Ewing's Sarcoma 0% (95% CI: 0.0-24.7), Neuroblastoma 0% (95% CI: 0.0-23.2), Rhabdomyosarcoma 7.1% (95% CI: 0.2-33.9)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional pharmacokinetics observed with Cmax ranging from 3488 ng/mL at 120 mg/m² to 8078 ng/mL at 270 mg/m²
subgroup_findings: Only rhabdomyosarcoma showed any response (7.1% ORR)
Disease control rate varied by tumor type: Ewing's sarcoma 30.8%, neuroblastoma 7.1%, rhabdomyosarcoma 7.1%
Median PFS: Ewing's sarcoma 13 weeks, neuroblastoma 7.4 weeks, rhabdomyosarcoma 5.1 weeks
safety_signals: 2 DLTs observed: 1 at 120 mg/m² (Grade 3/4 nonhematologic toxicity), 1 at 270 mg/m² (Grade 4 neutropenia >7 days)
Common serious AEs: febrile neutropenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia
Treatment-related deaths: 0 in Phase 1, 0 in Phase 2
results.dose_information: 120-270 mg/m² IV on Days 1, 8, and 15 of 28-day cycles; recommended Phase 2 dose: 240 mg/m²

context.duration: Median treatment duration Phase 1: 7.0 weeks; Phase 2: Ewing's sarcoma 14 weeks, neuroblastoma 7 weeks, rhabdomyosarcoma 5 weeks
